candidate_program.name: conservative_load_envelope
candidate_program.rationale: Discounts reward by the larger of actual blocker count and reward-normalized blocker mass. Reach is local count and aggregate weight; constant-size arithmetic adds no traversal, while active summaries remain charged. The conservative envelope may penalize mutually conflicting alternatives excessively.

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
